name: co.motifyme/motifyme
title: MotifyMe
description: UK car checks by reg: MOT, tax, history and factory spec reports, recalls, fuel prices, used cars.

tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search live used vehicle listings on the MotifyMe marketplace (UK dealers). Returns up to 20 results per call with price, mileage, dealer and the public listing url.

fuel_type.description: e.g. Petrol, Diesel, Electric, Petrol Hybrid

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full public details of one listing (spec, description, features, dealer, photos). Pass the listing id or its motifyme.co/marketplace url.

tools.name: list_makes_and_models
tools.description: Makes (and optionally models of one make) currently in stock with counts and the matching motifyme.co hub page url.

make.description: optional: a make to list models for

tools.name: search_dealers
tools.description: Find dealers on the marketplace by name or town. Returns name, town, stock count and the public storefront url (no contact details).

tools.name: get_dealer
tools.description: Public storefront summary for one dealer slug including a sample of their current stock.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search published MotifyMe blog posts (UK car buying, selling, finance introductions, running costs, fuel, tax, MOT). Returns title, summary, category, date and url.

category.description: e.g. Driving, Fuel, Running Costs, MOT & Tax

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Full text of one published blog post by slug or url.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.description: List public motifyme.co pages (guides, tools, finance pages, fuel price pages) from the sitemap, optionally filtered by keyword.

tools.name: get_site_page
tools.description: Readable text of a public motifyme.co page listed by list_site_pages (guides, fuel price city pages, tool pages).

tools.name: uk_fuel_prices
tools.description: Latest UK average petrol and diesel pump prices (pence per litre) from the weekly DESNZ road fuel prices, with weekly change.

tools.name: fuel_cost_calculator
tools.description: Cost of a journey or a year of driving for a petrol or diesel car. If price_per_litre_pence is omitted the latest UK average for that fuel is used.

tools.name: ev_charging_cost_calculator
tools.description: Cost to drive an electric car a given distance. All inputs are required so nothing is assumed.

price_pence_per_kwh.description: electricity price in pence per kWh

tools.name: company_car_tax_calculator
tools.description: Benefit-in-kind tax on a company car using the same bands as the MotifyMe calculator. Confirm current-year rates with HMRC before relying on the result.

electric_range_miles.description: only for plug-in hybrids with CO2 50 or less

diesel_not_rde2.description: diesel that does not meet RDE2

tools.name: vehicle_tax_estimate
tools.description: Estimated annual vehicle excise duty from CO2, engine size and first registration month, using the MotifyMe car tax logic.

tools.name: clean_air_zones
tools.description: List of UK clean air and low emission zones with daily charges and the official page for each.

tools.name: road_closures
tools.description: Current National Highways road closures (public data), optionally filtered by road such as M6.

tools.name: ev_chargers_near
tools.description: Nearest public EV charging locations within 10 miles of a UK postcode.

tools.name: vehicle_crime_near
tools.description: Latest month of police-reported vehicle crime near a UK postcode, with the most affected streets.

tools.name: ulez_check
tools.description: Whether a UK-registered vehicle is compliant with the London ULEZ and other clean air zones. Rate limited.

tools.name: car_running_costs
tools.description: Vehicle tax, MOT and other running-cost facts for a UK-registered vehicle. Rate limited.

tools.name: uk_car_news
tools.description: Latest UK motoring and automotive news headlines with short summaries and links to the full stories, supplied by Autosnip (FullyAuto). Optionally filter by keyword.

query.description: optional keyword, e.g. electric or MOT

tools.name: about_motifyme
tools.description: Who MotifyMe is, what it offers and the main public urls.

tools.name: ai_car_search
tools.description: Describe the used car you want in plain English, for example "diesel estate under 8000 no older than 8 years" or "2.0L Audi Q3 automatic" or "automatic with Apple CarPlay under 15000" (equipment such as CarPlay, Android Auto, sat nav, heated seats or a reversing camera is matched where the dealer lists it), and get matching live MotifyMe marketplace listings. If nothing matches every detail, the closest real cars are returned and the ignored details are listed.

request.description: Plain-English description of the car wanted

tools.name: price_and_fuel_alerts
tools.description: Free MotifyMe email alerts: an alert when the price drops on a car listed on the MotifyMe marketplace (set up from the car's listing page), and fuel price alerts for a chosen area and fuel, set up on the MotifyMe fuel price pages or on WhatsApp by sending FUEL ALERT. Returns the links to set each up.

tools.name: factory_spec_report
tools.description: What the paid MotifyMe factory specification report covers and the link to buy it: the original factory build of a UK car by registration, including make, model and derivative, engine and fuel type, the optional extras fitted at the factory with the list price of each option when new where the manufacturer price data is available, and the standard equipment for that version. Payment is only taken if a factory build record is found for the registration. Useful for buyers checking an advert matches the car, sellers listing the right options, and owners wanting to know what their car came with. Not every make is covered, and build records are not available for every vehicle, particularly older ones from before 2018; the checkout confirms the vehicle and says before payment if a make is not covered, and nothing is charged if no build record is found. This tool does not look up the build record itself. The link has the registration filled in when one is given.

registration.description: Optional UK registration plate, for example AB12 CDE

tools.name: free_vehicle_check
tools.description: Free check of a UK vehicle by registration plate. Answers what car a registration belongs to, whether it is taxed and when tax is due, whether its MOT is valid and when it runs out, and whether a safety recall is outstanding. Returns the make, model, colour, fuel type and year, the MOT status and expiry date, the tax status and due date, and the recall status, with a link that opens the full free result for that registration on MotifyMe (MOT history and a free valuation). Does not include outstanding finance, insurance write-offs or stolen records, which are only in the paid vehicle history check. Rate limited.

registration.description: UK registration plate, for example AB12 CDE

tools.name: how_many_left
tools.description: How many of a car model are still licensed on UK roads and how many are declared off the road (SORN), from DVLA vehicle licensing statistics published by the Department for Transport. Useful for "how many Ford Capris are left" style questions and for rare, classic and future-classic cars. Returns the latest quarter and a link to the MotifyMe page with the trend over time. Only models MotifyMe publishes a page for are covered.

model.description: Make and model, for example Ford Capri or Saab 9-3

tools.name: mot_pass_rate_rankings
tools.description: Ranks UK car models by first-time MOT pass rate with tests counted and average mileage at test, from DVSA anonymised MOT data under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Pass rates depend heavily on the age and mileage of the cars tested, so the ranking is not a like-for-like comparison. Optional: limit (default 20, max 120) and order ("highest" or "lowest").

limit.description: How many models to return (default 20, max 120)

tools.name: mot_statistics
tools.description: First-time MOT pass rate, most common failure areas and specific failures, average mileage at test and results by year of registration for a UK car model (for example make "Ford", model "Fiesta"), calculated from DVSA anonymised MOT test data under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The figures describe groups of cars, not any individual vehicle. If the model has no statistics yet, the models that do are listed.

tools.name: used_car_price_reductions
tools.description: Which used cars on the MotifyMe marketplace have had their price reduced, overall and by make: number of reduced cars and typical reduction, with links to browse them. Figures come from dealer price changes tracked on MotifyMe and describe MotifyMe listings only, not the whole UK market.

tools.name: sell_your_car
tools.description: How a private seller lists their own car on the MotifyMe marketplace: enter the registration, add details and photos, and publish the advert from £9.99. Includes the link to start. Also points to a free valuation first so the seller can price the car.

registration.description: Optional UK registration of the car being sold

tools.name: vehicle_history_check
tools.description: What the paid MotifyMe vehicle history check covers and the link to run it: stolen markers, insurance write-offs (Cat S, Cat N and older categories), outstanding finance, scrapped or salvaged, imported or exported, plate and colour changes, and number of previous keepers, for buyers and sellers of UK cars. This tool does not look up those records and its result is not confirmation that a vehicle is clear. The link has the registration filled in when one is given.

registration.description: Optional UK registration plate, for example AB12 CDE

tools.name: recalls_by_model
tools.description: Published UK safety recalls for a car make, or a make and model, from DVSA recall data: number of recalls, the most recent, and each recall reference with the build dates it covers. Whether one particular car is affected depends on its build date and VIN, so for a specific car run the free MotifyMe check with its registration first, which shows any outstanding recall.

registration.description: Optional UK registration of the car, to link the free check
